pages.title: Redstone and Displays
pages.text: Create adds ways to read and control machines without wires.

pages.title: Redstone Link
pages.text: Wireless. Pairs share a frequency set by two items. A powered transmitter powers receivers anywhere.

pages.title: Display Link
pages.text: Reads data from a block, such as a stock level, and writes it to a Display Board or Nixie Tubes.

pages.title: Smart Observer
pages.text: Detects items in front of it, in an inventory, or on a belt.

pages.title: Threshold Switch
pages.text: Outputs redstone based on how full a container is.
